cases.question: 上个月各品类订单退款率是多少？仅列有支付订单的品类，截至参考日期，结果列 category、refund_rate，保留6位小数。
cases.goldenSql: SELECT p.category,ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM refunds r WHERE r.order_item_id=i.id AND r.succeeded_at<'2026-11-14') THEN o.id END)/NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.id),0),6) AS refund_rate FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.id JOIN products p ON p.id=i.product_id WHERE o.status='PAID' AND o.paid_at>='2026-10-01' AND o.paid_at<'2026-11-01' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY p.category

evidence.sql_text:
SELECT p.category
	, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
		WHEN EXISTS (
				SELECT 1
				FROM refunds r
					JOIN order_items oi2 ON r.order_item_id = oi2.id
				WHERE oi2.order_id = o.id
					AND oi2.product_id = p.id
					AND r.status = 'SUCCESS'
					AND r.succeeded_at < '2026-11-14'
			)
		THEN o.id
	END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.id), 0), 6) AS refund_rate
FROM orders o
	JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
	JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE o.status = 'PAID'
	AND o.paid_at >= '2026-10-01'
	AND o.paid_at < '2026-11-01'
	AND o.shop_id = 1
	AND p.shop_id = 1
GROUP BY p.category
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) > 0
ORDER BY p.category

steps.sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM refunds r JOIN order_items oi2 ON r.order_item_id = oi2.id WHERE oi2.order_id = o.id AND oi2.product_id = p.id AND r.status = 'SUCCESS' AND r.succeeded_at < '2026-11-14') THEN o.id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.id), 0), 6) AS refund_rate FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'PAID' AND o.paid_at >= '2026-10-01' AND o.paid_at < '2026-11-01' AND o.shop_id = 1 AND p.shop_id = 1 GROUP BY p.category HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) > 0 ORDER BY p.category

metric.name: 退款金额
metric.definition: SUM(refunds.amount)，refunds 视图已按 refund_no 去重且仅含成功退款；每次成功的部分退款分别计入。

metric.name: 订单退款率
metric.definition: 统计期支付订单中，截至分析时点存在成功退款的去重订单数 / 同期支付订单去重数。品类维度退款必须关联该品类明细，使用 EXISTS 或先聚合退款避免 JOIN 放大。分母为零返回 NULL。
